title: The AI Daily — Morning Conversation
blurb: An American-English dialogue limited to publisher feed excerpts.
lines: Hey, welcome to The AI Daily. I'm Maya, and Ben is here with me. We've picked a few headlines from publisher news feeds to talk through.
Hi, Maya. These are short feed excerpts, not the full articles, so we'll keep the facts carefully attributed and avoid filling in the blanks.
Let's start with The Decoder. The headline is: OCR models now digitize a million pages for under $130 as costs drop fivefold in 18 months.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Pulling text out of scanned books and records has gotten a lot cheaper with freely available AI models. The article…
That brings us to Google News · Anthropic, which has this headline: Anthropic IPO: $83 Share Price and Year-End Valuation Odds - Time Magazine.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Anthropic IPO: $83 Share Price and Year-End Valuation Odds Time Magazine
Next up, LawSites reports: OpenAI Opens Astra for Law to All ChatGPT Enterprise Customers and Releases New Benchmark Results.
According to the publisher's excerpt, In September, OpenAI joined other frontier models that have been moving into the legal field, including Anthropic and Google, and…
And our fourth story is from Google News · Anthropic: Anthropic valued at $1.5 trillion ahead of AI giant's stock market debut - BBC.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Anthropic valued at $1.5 trillion ahead of AI giant's stock market debut BBC
Before we go, here's a useful expression: keep an eye on. It means watch something for changes — like a fast-moving AI story.
Exactly. And look into means investigate further. Follow the original reporting for context. See you in the next edition.
note: AI voices reading a conservative two-host script grounded only in publisher feed excerpts. Full article claims were not independently verified.
